description.zh: 资源ID列表，最多支持50个。资源类型为租户ID时不需要指定。
description.en: The list of resource IDs. A maximum of 50 resource IDs are supported. You do not need to specify this parameter when the resource type is tenant ID.

description.zh:
标签列表。支持系统标签和自定义标签。

- 系统标签枚举值：
   - `System/Scheduler/GRAYSCALE`：灰度标签
   - `System/Scheduler/STOP_NEW_USER_CONNECTION`：阻止交付组新绑定用户建连的标签

- 自定义标签：最多可创建20个。

> 同一个资源上的同一个标签键只能对应一个标签值。如果您尝试添加已有标签键，则对应的标签值会更新为新值。
description.en:
The list of tags. System tags and custom tags are supported.

- System tag enumeration values:
   - `System/Scheduler/GRAYSCALE`: canary release tag
   - `System/Scheduler/STOP_NEW_USER_CONNECTION`: tag that prevents new user connections from being established for the delivery group

- Custom tags: A maximum of 20 custom tags can be created.

> Each tag key on the same resource can have only one tag value. If you add a tag key that already exists, the corresponding tag value is updated to the new value.

description.zh: 标签键。区分大小写。长度范围：1\~128 个字符。
description.en: The tag key. This parameter is case-sensitive. The tag key must be 1 to 128 characters in length.

description.zh: 标签值。区分大小写。长度范围：1\~128 个字符。
description.en: The tag value. This parameter is case-sensitive. The tag value must be 1 to 128 characters in length.

title.zh: 为云资源创建并绑定标签
title.en: Create and attach tags to cloud resources
